annotations.target_phrase: His vision crawled with ghost hieroglyphs, translucent lines of symbols arranging themselves against the neutral backdrop
annotations.annotation_text: Case experiencing the matrix bleeding through into his optical perception: digital code and matrix coordinates projecting onto physical reality, illustrating the breakdown of the boundary between virtual and material space.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 261.

annotations.target_phrase: Linda, who told you? Who told you I’d come? Who?
annotations.annotation_text: Case confronting Linda Lee inside Neuromancer's simulated beach in Morocco, discovering that the AI preserves human subjectivity and memory within subjective virtual realities.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 261.
